_what_this_is: Per-stage inference-depth policy (cost-audit C2). `effort` maps an agent name to the Claude Code --effort level for that stage's subagent invocation; stages absent here run at the CLI default. Model TIER routing (haiku vs sonnet) stays in .claude/agents/*.md frontmatter and is a human decision (CLAUDE.md) — this file tunes only how hard the chosen model thinks.
_calibration_rule: Change a level only with a measured run behind it: fresh harness 17/17 plus the C0 token ruler (eval/cost_report.py --tokens). Never tune against fixtures/northlight_01/answer_key.json.
_provenance: C2 experiment 2026-07-25: render capped at low. Rationale: C1 measured sonnet-stage spend as thinking-dominated (30-53k output tokens vs ~7k-token artifacts), and render is the mechanical end of the sonnet pair — template-driven, with citation/glossary/warning-coverage gates that are all deterministic. Synthesis deliberately carries NO cap: conflict adjudication is the judgment core of the product. Measurement status (2026-09-23, review round 1): every harness-graded run predates the 2026-07-30 routing below (Haiku-era extraction, no verifier); the current routing is measured on one source only (runs/routing-validate-01: 598,743 tokens, sonnet, extraction 554,048 + verify-extract 44,695 — eval/cost_report.py). A replay of pipeline/extraction.py:risk_classes over every stored extract sends 66/66 unique extracts to strong_model, so the base_model branch was nominal (docs/EVAL_RECORD.md §6); owner decision 5 (2026-09-23) declared the verifier sonnet-only — see _verify_extract.
_verify_extract: Independent second check on every extract (pipeline step 4b). Routing is SONNET-ONLY (owner decision 5, 2026-09-23, docs/OPERATING_DECISIONS.md): `strong_model` and `base_model` are both sonnet, so every verification runs sonnet whatever the risk read says; the verify-extract frontmatter declares sonnet too. History: the 2026-07-30 decision routed extracts with any `risk_classes` to sonnet and the rest to haiku, but a replay of pipeline/extraction.py:risk_classes over every stored extract sent 66 of 66 to sonnet (docs/EVAL_RECORD.md §6) — `figures` fires on any digit, dates included, and `garbling` on ANY extraction_note (rule-U and context notes too, not only rule-G flags) — so the haiku branch never ran. The classes are still computed and recorded per extract in the run manifest (verification.risk_classes) as a descriptive risk read; with both models sonnet they no longer change routing, and their over-broad labels (`garbling` above all) are documented rather than relied on. A haiku path returns only by a new owner decision with redefined classes and a measured replay.
